intro: With newly forged weapons in hand, you are directed back from Stranglethorn Vale to the Blasted Lands. The spirit of the Fallen Hero of the Horde awaits your return to set you against the demon Razelikh.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The hour of redemption is near, friend. You must return to the Blasted Lands with your new-found weaponry and speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde to receive your final objective.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You look battle hardened, friend. Are you prepared to face Razelikh and his minions?
